4279-5933-6887--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-5933-6887--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Popular Egotist, The Skullspore Nexus and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the The Skullspore Nexus ability, creating a X/X Fungus creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Popular Egotist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

851-2457-4289-8201.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

141-1854-5147.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-1854-5147.description:
Cast Makeshift Mannequin by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Makeshift Mannequin.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Naru Meha, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Makeshift Mannequin
Resolve the Makeshift Mannequin copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6972-7236-8095.easyPrerequisites: The total toughness of creatures you control excluding Towering Titan is at least X.
6972-7236-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Towering Titan.
When Towering Titan dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

1981-2324-2415-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Proper Burial and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Proper Burial trigger, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, milling the targeted player a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

1496-1981-2415-6797.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1496-1981-2415-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

533-5431-7839.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature or artifact.
533-5431-7839.notablePrerequisites: The Flame of Keld's third chapter ability triggered this turn.
533-5431-7839.description:
Activate Makeshift Munitions by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature or artifact, dealing 2 damage to Smaug due to The Flame of Keld.
Smaug triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3899-6968-7824.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

3534-6798-7084.notablePrerequisites:
You control seven or more lands with different names.
You control another nonland creature.
You control another nonland creature.
You control seven or more lands that have different names.
3534-6798-7084.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, surveiling 1.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Field of the Dead triggers, creating a 2/2 black Zombie creature token
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, surveiling 1.
Repeat.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Field of the Dead triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.
3534-6798-7084.notes: The land you earthbend can be Field of the Dead.

1874-3054-3416-5670.easyPrerequisites: You've gained life this turn if Oathsworn Vampire is in your graveyard.
1874-3054-3416-5670.description:
Cast Oathsworn Vampire either from your hand or graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Edgar triggers, creating a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
When the Vampire and Oathsworn Vampire enter, Ajani's Welcome triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Warren Soultrader twice by paying 2 life and sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire and the Vampire token, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

3101-3292-3892-6633.easyPrerequisites: You have an amount of {R} available equal to three minus the number of +1/+1 counters on Runaway Steam-Kin.
3101-3292-3892-6633.description:
If Runaway Steam-Kin has three or more +1/+1 counters on it, activate it by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Cast Spear Spewer by paying {R}.
Runaway Steam-Kin triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Spear Spewer by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to each player.
Dissipation Field triggers, returning Spear Spewer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
3101-3292-3892-6633.notes: It is recommended to perform this combo when you have more life than your opponents to end the game, but it is not required. If this combo will not end the game, stop once you have 1 life.

4338-4875-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Cleric due to Conspiracy, Rotlung Reanimator triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

5276-6412-6798.description:
Cast Leonin Relic-Warder by paying {W}{W}.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Pre-War Formalwear.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Leonin Relic-Warder.
When Leonin Relic-Warder dies, its second ability triggers, returning Pre-War Formalwear from exile to the battlefield.
When Pre-War Formalwear enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Leonin Relic-Warder from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Pre-War Formalwear to it.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Pre-War Formalwear.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 3.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Optimus Prime, Hero // Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader

5231-5263-6243.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Hero, adding {R}.
When Optimus Prime, Hero dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader, adding {R}.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning Optimus Prime from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Hero as an Angel with flying.
Repeat.

717-4798-5014-5686.description:
Activate Putrid Imp by discarding Ovalchase Daredevil.
Bone Miser's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Putrid Imp ability.
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing the Zombie, creating a Blood token.
When the Blood enters the battlefield, Ovalchase Daredevil triggers, returning Ovalchase Daredevil from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

483-4186-4279.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least two additional creatures.
Scurry Oak has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Your life total is at least 2.
483-4186-4279.description:
Cast Yawgmoth by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Yawgmoth enters the battlefield, Scurry Oak's evolve ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Cruel Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, triggering Scurry Oak's second ability.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Cruel Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Scurry Oak's evolve ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, triggering Scurry Oak's second ability.
Repeat from step 7.

4289-4687-4929.notablePrerequisites:
Cryptic Trilobite has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
Gilder Bairn does not have summoning sickness.
4289-4687-4929.description:
Activate Gilder Bairn by tapping it, adding {G/U}.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite, you may instead double the counters on any other permanent(s).

1633-2060-3415-4120-4772.description:
Cast Hanabi Blast by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve Hanabi Blast, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Vigor's first ability, and then returning Hanabi Blast to your hand and discarding a card at random.
Conspiracy Theorist's second ability triggers, allowing you to exile the discarded card from your graveyard if it was a nonland card and cast it from exile this turn.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Cast Hanabi Blast either from your hand or from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite colored mana, you may instead target any other creature and/or player with Hanabi Blast.

3718-3926.notablePrerequisites: You control an indestructible noncreature permanent.
3718-3926.description:
Cast Chain of Acid by paying {3}{G}, targeting an indestructible noncreature permanent you control.
Eager First-Year triggers, giving itself +1/+0 until end of turn.
Resolve Chain of Acid, destroying nothing and causing you to copy Chain of Acid, targeting an indestructible noncreature permanent you control.
Repeat from step 2.

129-4289-4824.description:
Activate Soliton by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Soliton by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.
129-4289-4824.notes: Once you have infinite {U}, you can instead tap for other colors of mana. Notably, you can tap for {G} to use Kinnan's ability.

718-719-3809-4508.description:
Activate Kumano by paying {1}{R}, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}{R}.
Repeat.

618-3151-5200.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of the Paruns attached to Kiki-Jiki.
You control at least four Elves.
618-3151-5200.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Elvish Archdruid with haste.
Activate the Elvish Archdruid token by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

903-2199-2524.description:
Activate Frenetic Efreet an arbitrarily large number of times by paying a total of {0}.
Resolve the first Frenetic Efreet ability, flipping a coin and either sacrificing Frenetic Efreet or causing it to phase out.
If you won the flip, Karplusan Minotaur's first ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target.
If you lost the flip, Karplusan Minotaur's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target of an opponent's choice.
Serra's Emissary prevents you or a creature you control from being targeted by an opponent.
Resolve the next Frenetic Efreet ability, flipping a coin and not sacrificing Frenetic Efreet or causing it to phase out due to it no longer being on the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1235-2034-2634-4783.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {1}{R}, targeting Hellkite Courser.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it to your hand, targeting Twinflame.
Choose to have Rootha returned to the command zone instead of your hand.
Resolve the Rootha ability, copying Twinflame, targeting Hellkite Courser.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Hellkite Courser.
Hellkite Courser enters the battlefield, putting Rootha from the command zone onto the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Hellkite Courser token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

2257-4508-4875.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
2257-4508-4875.description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Reckless Fireweaver triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, as Reckless Fireweaver is a Pirate due to Conspiracy, creating a Treasure token for each opponent dealt damage this way.
When the Treasure(s) enter, Reckless Fireweaver triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Reckless Fireweaver trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3.
